spl_product_data_elements: Amcon Labs Hand Sanitizer Fragrance Free Gel Sanitizer Alcohol PROPYLENE GLYCOL CARBOMER INTERPOLYMER TYPE A (ALLYL SUCROSE CROSSLINKED) WATER GLYCERIN TROLAMINE ALCOHOL ALCOHOL water white - colorless, crystal clear
indications_and_usage: Use Hand sanitizer to help reduce amount of bacteria on the skin
warnings: Warnings Flammable. Keep away from fire or flame. For external use only. If swallowed, seek medical attention. When using this product do not use around or near the eyes. If contact occurs, flush eyes with water and contact doctor immediately. Keep out of reach of children.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children.
dosage_and_administration: Directions Place a small amount of product in one hand. Spread on hands and run into skin until dry. Place a smaller amount into one hand and spread over both hands and wrists. Rub into skin until dry. Children should be supervised while using this product.
inactive_ingredient: Inactive Ingredients Water, Propylene Glycol, Carbomer, Glycerin, Triethanolamine

brand_name: Amcon Labs Hand Sanitizer Fragrance Free Gel Sanitizer
